# SOAL NOMOR 1
```{r}
# Impor Dataset
orders <- read.csv("../data/orders.csv")
order_details <- read.csv("../data/order_details.csv")
pizzas <- read.csv("../data/pizzas.csv")
pizza_types <- read.csv("../data/pizza_types.csv")
```

```{r}
# Penggabungan (Merge) seluruh tabel berdasarkan identifier bersama
library(tidyverse)
df1_merged <- order_details %>%
  inner_join(pizzas, by = "pizza_id") %>%
  inner_join(pizza_types, by = "pizza_type_id") %>%
  inner_join(orders, by = "order_id") %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    revenue = quantity * price
  )
head(df1_merged)
```

## NOMOR 1 BAGIAN A
```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
# (i) Bar chart: Top 10 Pizza Types berdasarkan total unit terjual
top10_pizza <- df1_merged %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(total_quantity = sum(quantity)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_quantity)) %>%
  slice(1:10)

ggplot(top10_pizza, aes(x = reorder(name, total_quantity), y = total_quantity)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2b5c8f", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = total_quantity), 
            hjust = -0.15,
            size = 3.5, 
            color = "black") + 
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Pizza Types dengan Penjualan Tertinggi (2015)",
    x = "Jenis Pizza",
    y = "Total Unit Terjual"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, color = "black", face = "bold")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))
```

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
# (ii) Line chart: Pendapatan Harian (Daily Revenue) sepanjang tahun 2015
daily_revenue <- df1_merged %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(total_revenue = sum(revenue))

ggplot(daily_revenue, aes(x = date, y = total_revenue)) +
  geom_line(color = "#e65c00", linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Tren Pendapatan Harian Restoran Pizza (Tahun 2015)",
    x = "Tanggal",
    y = "Pendapatan Harian ($)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    # Mengubah warna teks angka sumbu dan label judul sumbu menjadi hitam

    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 11, face = "bold")
)
```

## NOMOR 1 BAGIAN B
```{r}
# Mengagregasi total kuantitas unit pizza per order_id
order_quantity <- df1_merged %>%
  group_by(order_id) %>%
  summarise(X = sum(quantity))
head(order_quantity)
```

```{r}
# (i) Empirical Probability Mass Function (PMF) dari X
empirical_pmf <- order_quantity %>%
  count(X) %>%
  mutate(pmf = n / sum(n))
print(empirical_pmf)
```

```{r}
# (ii) Nilai Ekspektasi Empiris (Mean) dan Variansi Empiris dari X
mean_X <- mean(order_quantity$X)
var_X <- var(order_quantity$X)

cat("Nilai Ekspektasi Empiris E[X] =", round(mean_X, 4), "\n")
cat("Variansi Empiris Var(X)       =", round(var_X, 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
# (iii) Fitting Distribusi Poisson dengan lambda = mean_X
lambda_hat <- mean_X

prob_poisson_eq_2 <- dpois(x = 2, lambda = lambda_hat)
prob_poisson_le_3 <- ppois(q = 3, lambda = lambda_hat)

cat("P(X = 2) Teoretis Poisson  =", round(prob_poisson_eq_2, 4), "\n")
cat("P(X <= 3) Teoretis Poisson =", round(prob_poisson_le_3, 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
# (iv) Perbandingan Probabilitas Teoretis vs Empiris
prob_emp_eq_2 <- 0.2881499
prob_emp_le_3 <- 0 + 0.3799063 + 0.2881499 + 0.1502108

cat("P(X = 2) Empiris   =", round(prob_emp_eq_2, 4), "\n")
cat("P(X <= 3) Empiris  =", round(prob_emp_le_3, 4), "\n")
```

## NOMOR 1 BAGIAN C
```{r}
# Agregasi total kuantitas per tanggal & klasifikasi Weekday/Weekend
daily_sales <- df1_merged %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(total_quantity = sum(quantity)) %>%
  mutate(
    day_name = wday(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    day_type = if_else(day_name %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday"), "Weekend", "Weekday"),
    day_type = factor(day_type, levels = c("Weekday", "Weekend"))
)
head(daily_sales)
```

```{r}
# (ii) Uji Asumsi Normalitas
library(nortest)
lillie.test(daily_sales$total_quantity[daily_sales$day_type == "Weekday"])
lillie.test(daily_sales$total_quantity[daily_sales$day_type == "Weekend"])

# Uji Asumsi Homogenitas Variansi
var.test(total_quantity ~ day_type, data = daily_sales)
```


```{r}
# Penanganan Asumsi Normalitas (Tranformasi Box-cox)
library(AID)
library(MASS)
library(car)
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Transformasi Box-cox dengan library AID
out = boxcoxnc(weekday_qty, method = "mle", lambda = seq(-2,2,0.001), verbose = F, plot = F)
out$lambda.hat

# 2. Transformasi Box-cox dengan library MASS

out$x[which.max(out$y)]

# 3. Transformasi Box-cox dengan library Car
out = powerTransform(weekday_qty, family ="bcPower")
out$lambda
```

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
# Transformasi Data Berdasarkan Nilai Lambda
transformasi.bc=function(data, lambda){
  for(i in 1:length(data)){
    data[i]=-1*(data[i]^lambda)
    }
  return(data)
  }
weekday_qty_tr = tfbc=transformasi.bc(weekday_qty, -0.678)

# Membuat boxplot setelah transformasi
boxplot(weekday_qty_tr,
        main = "Boxplot Penjualan (Weekday) Setelah Transformasi",
        ylab = "Total Quantity",
        col = "skyblue",
        border = "black",
        pch = 19,
        outcol = "red"
)
```

## NOMOR 1 BAGIAN D
```{r}
# Agregasi total pendapatan per tanggal & tetapkan ke Bulan
daily_revenue_month <- df1_merged %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(total_revenue = sum(revenue)) %>%
  mutate(
    month = factor(month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE), levels = month.name)
)
head(daily_revenue_month)
```

```{r}
# (ii) Asumsi Normalitas Residual
library(nortest)
anova_fit <- aov(total_revenue ~ month, data = daily_revenue_month)
lillie.test(residuals(anova_fit))

# Asumsi Homogenitas Variansi
library(car)
leveneTest(total_revenue ~ month, data = daily_revenue_month)
```

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
# Membuat boxplot residual
boxplot(residuals(anova_fit),
        main = "Boxplot Residual ANOVA",
        ylab = "Residuals",
        col = "skyblue",
        border = "black",
        pch = 19,
        outcol = "red")
```

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
# Membuat histogram residual
hist(residuals(anova_fit),
     main = "Histogram Residual ANOVA",
     xlab = "Residuals",
     ylab = "Frekuensi",
     col = "skyblue",
     border = "black",
     breaks = 12)
```

```{r}
# (iii) Pengujian ANOVA Satu Arah
summary(aov(total_revenue ~ month, data = daily_revenue_month))
```

## NOMOR 2 BAGIAN B
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# 1. Penanganan Data Orders Date
df_orders <- orders_date_raw %>%
  separate_rows(Orders, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  separate(Orders, into = c("Order ID", "Order Time"), sep = " - ") %>%
  mutate(
    `Order ID`   = as.numeric(`Order ID`),
    `Order Date` = as.Date(Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
    `Order Time` = trimws(`Order Time`)
  ) %>%
  select(`Order ID`, `Order Date`, `Order Time`)

cat("[1] df_orders berhasil diparsing. Total baris bersih:", nrow(df_orders), "\n")

# 2. Penanganan Data Pizza Order List
df_pol <- pizza_order_list_raw %>%
  rename(timestamp_raw = date, items_str = `pizza.order.list.with.quantity`) %>%
  separate_rows(items_str, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(
    items_str = trimws(items_str),
    Quantity = as.numeric(sub(".*\\s+(\\d+)$", "\\1", items_str)),
    `Pizza Name ID` = sub("\\s+\\d+$", "", items_str),
    dt_parsed = parse_date_time(timestamp_raw, orders = "HMS m-d-Y"),
    `Order Date` = as.Date(dt_parsed),
    `Order Time` = format(dt_parsed, "%H:%M:%S")
  ) %>%
  select(`Order Date`, `Order Time`, `Pizza Name ID`, Quantity)

cat("[2] df_pol berhasil di-unnest dan diparsing. Total baris item:", nrow(df_pol), "\n")

# 3. Penanganan Data Ratings
df_ratings <- ratings_raw %>%
  mutate(
    rating_service = ifelse(rating_service %in% c("-", "na", ""), NA, rating_service),
    rating_pizza   = ifelse(rating_pizza %in% c("-", "na", "", ""), NA, rating_pizza),
    `Service Rating` = as.numeric(rating_service),
    `Pizza Rating`   = as.numeric(rating_pizza)
  ) %>%
  rename(`Order ID` = order_id) %>%
  select(`Order ID`, `Service Rating`, `Pizza Rating`)

cat("[3] df_ratings dibersihkan dari string anomali ('-', 'na'). Total baris:", nrow(df_ratings), "\n")

# 4. Penggabungan (Merge) Tabel Data Pizza Info & Pizza Prices
df_pizza_lookup <- pizza_info_raw %>%
  rename(`Pizza Name ID` = pizza_name_id, `Pizza Name` = pizza_name, `Pizza Size` = pizza_size) %>%
  left_join(
    pizza_prices_raw %>% rename(`Pizza Name` = pizza_name, `Pizza Size` = pizza_size, `Unit Price` = unit_price),
    by = c("Pizza Name", "Pizza Size")
  )

cat("[4] df_pizza_lookup berhasil digabung. Total baris master pizza:", nrow(df_pizza_lookup), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Penggabungan Utama berpatokan pada df_orders
combined_df <- df_orders %>%
  inner_join(df_pol, by = c("Order Date", "Order Time")) %>%
  left_join(df_pizza_lookup, by = "Pizza Name ID") %>%
  left_join(df_ratings, by = "Order ID") %>%

    `Total Price` = Quantity * `Unit Price`,
    `Order Date`  = format(`Order Date`, "%m/%d/%Y")
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Order ID`, `Pizza Name ID`, Quantity, `Order Date`, `Order Time`,
    `Unit Price`, `Total Price`, `Pizza Size`, `Pizza Name`,
    `Service Rating`, `Pizza Rating`
)
head(combined_df, 10)
```

## NOMOR 2 BAGIAN D
```{r}
# HYBRID INTERPOLATION FUNCTION (LINEAR - EXPONENTIAL DECAY) tanpa library eksternal
hybrid_interpolate <- function(y, G_max = 10, alpha = 0.1) {
  n <- length(y)
  y_filled <- y
  
  known_idx <- which(!is.na(y))
  if (length(known_idx) == 0) return(y_filled)
  if (length(known_idx) < 2) {
    # Jika hanya ada 1 titik valid, isi semua dengan titik tersebut
    y_filled[is.na(y_filled)] <- y[known_idx[1]]
    return(y_filled)
  }
  
  # 1. Jalankan interpolasi utama
  for (k in 1:(length(known_idx) - 1)) {
    l <- known_idx[k]
    r <- known_idx[k + 1]
    if (r - l > 1) {
      g <- r - l
      y_l <- y[l]
      y_r <- y[r]
      for (i in (l + 1):(r - 1)) {
        delta <- (i - l) / g
        if (g <= G_max) {
          y_filled[i] <- y_l + (y_r - y_l) * delta
        } else {
          y_filled[i] <- y_r - (y_r - y_l) * (1 - exp(-alpha * delta))
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # 2. Penanganan Edge Cases (Base R murni untuk ujung awal & akhir)
  first_valid <- known_idx[1]
  last_valid <- known_idx[length(known_idx)]
  
  # Isi leading NA (sebelum titik valid pertama) dengan nilai valid pertama
  if (first_valid > 1) {
    y_filled[1:(first_valid - 1)] <- y_filled[first_valid]
  }
  # Isi trailing NA (setelah titik valid terakhir) dengan nilai valid terakhir
  if (last_valid < n) {
    y_filled[(last_valid + 1):n] <- y_filled[last_valid]
  }
  
  return(y_filled)
}

# Pengujian Fungsi dengan Sampel Data dari Soal
sample_y <- c(2.0, 2.4, NA, NA, 3.1, 3.5, 3.9, 4.2, 4.6, 5.0, 
              NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, 12.0)

test_filled <- hybrid_interpolate(sample_y, G_max = 3, alpha = 0.5)
cat("\nHasil Uji Fungsi Interpolasi Hibrida pada Sampel Data\n")
print(round(test_filled, 2))
```

# NOMOR 2 BAGIAN F
```{r}
# Fungsi Statistika Deskriptif tanpa mean(), median(), sd(), min(), max() bawaan R
calculate_manual_stats <- function(df) {
  # Ambil hanya variabel numerik
  numeric_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
  
  res_list <- list()
  
  for (col in numeric_cols) {
    x <- df[[col]]
    x <- x[!is.na(x)] # Hapus NA
    
    n_val <- length(x)
    if (n_val == 0) next
    
    # 1. Calculation of Mean
    sum_val <- 0
    for (val in x) sum_val <- sum_val + val
    mean_val <- sum_val / n_val
    
    # 2. Calculation of Minimum & Maximum
    min_val <- x[1]
    max_val <- x[1]
    for (val in x) {
      if (val < min_val) min_val <- val
      if (val > max_val) max_val <- val
    }
    
    # 3. Calculation of Median
    x_sorted <- sort(x)
    if (n_val %% 2 == 1) {
      median_val <- x_sorted[(n_val + 1) / 2]
    } else {
      median_val <- (x_sorted[n_val / 2] + x_sorted[(n_val / 2) + 1]) / 2
    }
    
    # 4. Calculation of Standard Deviation (Sample SD)
    sum_sq_diff <- 0
    for (val in x) {
      sum_sq_diff <- sum_sq_diff + (val - mean_val)^2
    }
    sd_val <- sqrt(sum_sq_diff / (n_val - 1))
    
    # Simpan hasil
    res_list[[col]] <- data.frame(
      Variable = col,
      Mean     = round(mean_val, 4),
      Median   = round(median_val, 4),
      Std_Dev  = round(sd_val, 4),
      Min      = round(min_val, 4),
      Max      = round(max_val, 4)
    )
  }
  
  final_stats <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
  rownames(final_stats) <- NULL
  return(final_stats)
}

# Jalankan Fungsi Statistik Manual pada Dataset Bersih
summary_table <- calculate_manual_stats(combined_df_clean)
summary_table
```
